lesson-intro.text: Halloween isn't complete without a bubbling cauldron. This one has a green brew, a ladle and a fire underneath. Watch it bubble up, then stir a pot of your own.

ladle.text: Start with the ladle's handle, a long stick leaning to the right.

rim.text: The rim is a wide oval. From the handle, go round each side and meet at the front.

brew.text: Inside it, a smaller oval for the brew, again from the handle round both sides.

pot.text: The pot hangs from the rim, a round belly wider than the rim. One side, then the other.

legs.text: Three short legs stand under the belly: left, middle and right.

flames.text: Between the legs burn two flames with three tips each, a small flame inside each one.

bubbles.text: Five bubbles: three on the brew, two floating up into the air.

gray.text: The rim and the legs are gray.

greens.text: Color the brew green and the bubbles pale green.

fire.text: Brown for the ladle, red and yellow for the flames.

lesson-outro.text: Your cauldron is bubbling away. Whatever's in it, maybe don't taste it.
